title: Second Battle of Agordat
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of Agordat", at revision 1370735850, opens: "The Second Battle of Agordat was fought in late December 1893, between Italian colonial troops and Mahdists from Sudan. Emir Ahmed Ali campaigned against the Italian forces in eastern Sudan and led about 10,000–12,000 men east from Kassala. This force encountered 2,400 Italians and their Eritrean askaris at Agordat, west of Asmara, commanded by Colonel Arimondi. Over 1,000 Dervishes, including the Emir, were killed in severe fighting. The outcome of the battle constituted "...the first decisive victory yet won by Europeans against the Sudanese revolutionaries,..."" That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q665983, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1893 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
